mapper.select: select lr.report_item_name propertyName, CONCAT(lr.result,lr.units) result from (select test_no from mp_lab_test_master where patient_id=#{personId} ORDER BY results_rpt_date_time desc limit 1) lm inner join mp_lab_result lr on lr.test_no=lm.test_no where (${condition})

insert into res_text_${researchId} ( record_id, form_id, property_code, property_value, property_id ) VALUES
(#{recordId}, #{item.formId}, #{item.propertyCode}, #{item.propertyValue}, #{item.propertyId})
